sloka: उत्तरेण दशग्रीवः प्रविवेशानिवर्तकः ।दक्षिणेन तु पार्श्वेन प्रविवेश शतक्रतुः ।। ७.२९.१८ ॥
transliteration: uttareṇa daśagrīvaḥ praviveśānivartakaḥ ।dakṣiṇena tu pārśvena praviveśa śatakratuḥ ।। 7.29.18 ॥

translations.english: Dashagriva entered from the northern side without retreating, while Shatakratu entered from the southern side.
